name: Dangerous Deletion
message: Recursive force delete (rm -rf) is irreversible. This is blocked.
suggestion: Move files to /tmp first, or use a safer deletion command.

name: Dangerous sudo
suggestion: Review this command carefully. Are you sure you need sudo here?

name: Invalid Phase Number
message: Phase 0 does not exist. GSD phases start at 1.
suggestion: Use /gsd:execute-phase 1 to start from the beginning.

name: Unknown GSD Command
description: Warns when a /gsd: command is not recognized
message: Unknown GSD command. This may not be a valid command.
suggestion: Run /gsd:verify-health to check your GSD installation.

name: Missing Phase Argument
description: Warns when execute-phase or verify-work is called without an argument
message: This command requires a phase number argument.

name: Force Push Detected
description: Warns about git force push which rewrites remote history
message: Force push detected. This will rewrite remote history.
suggestion: Consider using --force-with-lease for safer force pushes.
